title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors immediately surrounding Baylor University, featuring student-favorite dining, retail, and local landmarks.

cards.title: Quick Bites Near Campus
cards.subtitle: S 5th St between I-35 and Bagby Ave
cards.notes: Grab a sub at Jersey Mike's or a quick sandwich at Subway along this high-traffic corridor directly adjacent to the university's western edge.
cards.short_summary: A primary commercial corridor on the western edge of campus featuring national fast-casual dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Jersey Mike's is located at 720 S 5th St #108 and Subway is at 1020 S 5th St, both serving the Baylor area.
cards.source_title: Jersey Mike's Subs – S 5th Street - Visit Waco, TX
cards.access_notes: Public street with metered and business-specific parking; walkable from campus.

cards.title: Late Night Burger Runs
cards.subtitle: S 7th St near Speight Ave
cards.notes: Visit the local Whataburger for a classic Texas burger experience, a staple for students looking for late-night dining near the university.
cards.short_summary: A bustling thoroughfare known for its dining options, including the iconic 24-hour Whataburger.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger is located at 928 S 7th St, Waco, TX, providing 24-hour service near Baylor.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 928 S 7TH ST WACO, TX
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for dine-in and drive-thru.

cards.title: Study Sessions and Soup
cards.subtitle: S 8th St at I-35
cards.notes: Meet for group projects or a quiet study session at Panera Bread, conveniently located just across the highway from the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A commercial block featuring Panera Bread, serving as a popular off-campus study and meeting spot.
cards.evidence_claim: Panera Bread is located at 1000 S 8th St in Waco, TX, offering dine-in and pickup services.
cards.source_title: Panera Bread at 1000 S 8th St Waco, TX
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the I-35 frontage road; ample parking available.

cards.title: Student Living Corridor
cards.subtitle: Speight Ave between S 11th and S 15th
cards.notes: Walk this street to find local favorites like Jimmy John's and various student-oriented apartment complexes within walking distance of class.
cards.short_summary: A key residential and commercial street for Baylor students, housing several popular eateries and housing options.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's is located at 1508 Speight Ave, serving the Baylor student population.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Waco | Jimmy John's 2440
cards.access_notes: Pedestrian-friendly street with limited street parking.

cards.title: The Student Housing Hub
cards.subtitle: Bagby Ave near S 5th St
cards.notes: Navigate the heart of off-campus living where major apartment complexes like The Centre and 19Eleven house a large portion of the student body.
cards.short_summary: A primary residential street for upperclassmen, lined with modern student apartment communities.
cards.evidence_claim: The 19Eleven/The Centre apartments are located at 600 Bagby Ave, catering specifically to Baylor students.
cards.access_notes: Residential street; parking is typically reserved for residents of the various complexes.

cards.title: Iconic West Coast Burgers
cards.subtitle: S 4th St at I-35
cards.notes: Experience the popular In-N-Out Burger, a frequent stop for students located at the gateway between campus and downtown Waco.
cards.short_summary: A commercial block featuring In-N-Out Burger and Chipotle, serving as a major dining destination for the Baylor community.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out Burger is located at 801 South 4th St. and Chipotle is at 721 S 4th St.
cards.source_title: Waco, TX, 801 South 4th St.. - In-N-Out Burger
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 1:00 AM (1:30 AM on Fri/Sat).

cards.title: Antique Shopping and Soul Food
cards.subtitle: La Salle Ave near S 12th St
cards.notes: Explore the LaSalle Shoppes for unique finds or grab a home-cooked meal at Jess Soul Food along this historic Waco thoroughfare.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial avenue south of campus known for its antique malls and local eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: LaSalle Shoppes is located at 2223 La Salle Ave and Jess Soul Food is at 810 La Salle Ave.
cards.access_notes: Public street with storefront parking; LaSalle Shoppes is open Mon-Sat 10 AM - 5 PM.

cards.title: Riverfront Recreation
cards.subtitle: University Parks Dr along the Brazos River
cards.notes: Walk or bike along the Brazos River on this scenic drive that connects the campus to downtown and the Cameron Park trail system.
cards.short_summary: A scenic road bordering the campus and the Brazos River, offering access to parks and riverfront views.
cards.evidence_claim: University Parks Drive runs along the Brazos River, providing access to the Waco Riverwalk and campus facilities.
cards.access_notes: Public road with adjacent paved walking trails; free to access.

cards.title: Modern Student Living
cards.subtitle: S 11th St at Speight Ave
cards.notes: Find modern apartment living at 11th Street Flats, a popular choice for students seeking proximity to both campus and the La Salle corridor.
cards.short_summary: A residential street featuring newer apartment developments popular with the Baylor student community.
cards.evidence_claim: 11th Street Flats is located at 1722 S 11th St, offering 2, 3, and 4-bedroom options for students.
cards.access_notes: Residential area; primarily accessible by foot or bike for local students.

cards.title: Campus Perimeter Access
cards.subtitle: Dutton Ave between S 4th and S 8th
cards.notes: Utilize the Dutton Avenue Office and Parking Facility for campus visits or to access the university's western administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: A street on the western edge of campus primarily serving university administrative and parking needs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dutton Avenue Office and Parking Facility is a key university structure located along this street.
cards.source_title: Dutton Avenue Office and Parking Facility - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Parking facility requires a university permit or paid visitor parking.
